title: Isezerano ryatumiye ugusenyuka
intro: Ibaze ko uri munsi y’igisenge kimwe n’ivy’ihishurwa, yamara ugahitamwo ubudahemuka butandukanye. Uwo mubare wabayeho hafi cane y’ukuri n’ubuhanuzi, ariko akahindukirira abavyanka. Inkuru yabo ihagaze nk’imburi ikomeye y’uko kwegera ubugororotsi gusa bidashobora gukiza umutima uhemukira icizigiro.
clues: Nabaye mu rugo rw’umuhanuzi yatowe na Allah.
Nari nzi ukuri umugabo wanje yamamaza, yamara sinakwemera vy’ukuri.
Narahemukiye ukwizigira kwiwe mu gushigikira abantu biwe banse no kubafasha kumurwanya.
Ndavugwa iruhande y’uwundi mugore w’umuhanuzi na we nyene yahemukiye, nk’akarorero ku batemera.
Inkuru yanje ivugwa muri Sura At-Tahrim nk’imburi y’uko ubuvukanyi n’abahanuzi ataco butanga.
Narazimanganye n’abanyavyaha igihe Allah yatikiza abantu ba Luti, asigarana n’abasigaye.

trial.label: Igerageza/Ivyabaye
options: Yahemukiye umuhanuzi mu gufasha abahakanyi kumurwanya .
Jugunya uruyoya mu ruzi mu giseke kugira ngo urukize
Yasavye ko inyana y’inzahabu yubakwa mu gihe uwo muhanuzi atahari .
Yagirije umusuku w’umugororotsi ko yakoze ikibi maze aramufunga .
Yarongoye ingabo z'inzovu kugira ngo zisambure Kaaba .
trial.answer: Yahemukiye umuhanuzi mu gufasha abahakanyi kumurwanya .

location.label: Ikintu nyamukuru
options: Ico kinogo c'ubuhungiro c'abakiri bato basinziriye .

outcome.label: Ingaruka
options: Yarakijijwe hamwe n'abizera yinjira mw'Iparadizo amahoro .
Yahinduwe inkingi nk’ikimenyetso c’ibihe vyo mu nyuma .
Yamizwe n'isi afise ubutunzi bwinshi cane .

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
